views.name: cards_core_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.multiverseId AS printed_multiverseId
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical per-card projection with key identity columns and commonly filtered/queried attributes (string normalization left to consumer). Keeps raw source values but exposes important ids used for joins and external lookups.

views.name: cards_by_uuid_with_foreign_and_legal_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id_example,
  COALESCE(fd.foreign_data_count, 0) AS foreign_data_count,
  COALESCE(lg.legalities_count, 0) AS legalities_count
FROM cards_core_projection c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS foreign_data_count
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY uuid
) fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS legalities_count
  FROM legalities
  GROUP BY uuid
) lg ON lg.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: One row per card uuid enriched with counts of related foreign_data and legalities rows — useful to filter cards that have translations or many legality entries. Keeps raw uuid and counts as measures.

views.name: cards_with_set_info_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  cards.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  sets.name AS "sets.name AS set_name",
  sets.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate"
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN sets ON cards.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized per-card row joining basic set metadata (releaseDate, name) from sets using cards.setCode -> sets.code. Useful when answering questions that need card + set attributes together.

views.name: cards_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ccp.id AS id,
  ccp.name AS name,
  ccp.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  ccp.cardKingdomId AS cardKingdomId,
  ccp.cardKingdomFoilId AS cardKingdomFoilId,
  ccp.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards_core_projection ccp
LEFT JOIN cards ON cards.uuid = ccp.uuid
views.description: Canonical per-card row with key identity and primary metadata normalized/selected for card-level queries (one row per card). Does not apply question-specific filtering.

views.name: cards_powerful_foil_availability_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  cardKingdomId,
  cardKingdomFoilId,
  CASE
    WHEN cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL AND trim(cardKingdomId) <> ''
     AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND trim(cardKingdomFoilId) <> ''
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS has_powerful_foil
FROM cards_core_projection
views.description: Per-card indicator whether the card has both a cardKingdomId and a cardKingdomFoilId (i.e., 'powerful foils' available). Keeps one row per card and exposes the boolean flag for easy filtering.

views.name: cards_border_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.borderColor,
  c.setCode,
  c.cardKingdomId,
  c.cardKingdomFoilId
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.borderColor = '<border_color_literal_to_be_provided_in_question_ops>'
views.description: Cohort of cards filtered by borderColor value(s). One row per card; useful to quickly restrict analyses to particular border styles (e.g., borderless) without embedding literals into reusable analytic logic.

views.name: cards_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.number AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.text AS text
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized card printings with canonical key columns and common attributes used for filtering and display (one row per card printing). Cleans nothing aggressively but projects stable identifier, display fields, set and rarity fields used in queries.

views.name: card_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  format,
  status
FROM
  legalities
views.description: Row-level cohort of card legality statements (one row per legalities.id) linking card uuid to a format and status. Useful to filter by format and status for any card-level query.

views.name: card_printing_with_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.number AS number,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS "legalities.id"
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining card printings to their legalities (one row per cards.id x legalities.id) so each printing-format-status combination is explicit. Exposes card display fields plus legality format/status for direct filtering and reporting.

views.name: cards_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  uuid,
  name,
  types,
  side
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card (canonical card-level projection). Normalizes and exposes core card identity, type/sides, and name fields used for filtering and joining to other card-related tables.

views.name: legalities_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT card_legalities.uuid AS uuid,
       card_legalities.format AS format,
       card_legalities.status AS status,
       card_legalities.id AS id
FROM card_legalities
views.description: One row per legality entry for a card and format. Exposes card uuid, format, and status for filtering and joining.

views.name: cards_with_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.types AS types,
  c.side AS side,
  l.format AS format,
  l.status AS status,
  l.id AS "legalities.id"
FROM cards_row_level c
JOIN card_legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized card-to-legalities join at the card-legalities record level. One row per cards.uuid + legalities.id (legal entry). Useful for queries that need card attributes alongside legality status in specific formats.

views.name: cards_row_level_12
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.artist), '') AS artist,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.uuid), '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.power), '') AS power,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.name), '') AS name,
  NULLIF(trim(cards.setCode), '') AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card (canonicalized core card fields). Exposes card identifiers and core attributes used for filtering and display (power, artist, uuid, id and basic print/set info). Performs minimal normalization (treats empty strings as NULL where helpful).

views.name: card_legalities_13
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status,
  legalities.id AS id
FROM legalities
views.description: One row per card-format legality. Exposes the card uuid and format/status so callers can filter by format and legality status. Useful for asking which cards are legal in which formats.

views.name: card_with_commander_legality
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.artist AS artist,
  c.power AS power,
  l.format AS format,
  l.status AS status
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view: one row per card (cards.id) with an indicator whether the card is Legal/Not Legal in a given format. Does not bake any specific format value; format is an exposed column to filter by. Useful for answering format-specific cohorts (e.g., commander-legal cards) alongside card attributes.
counter_examples: What percentage of cards with format commander and legal status do not have a content warning?

views.name: cards_base_15
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.artist AS artist,
  c.hasContentWarning AS hasContentWarning
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Row-level canonical projection of the cards table exposing identity, artist, basic flags and textual fields used for filtering or output. One row per card.

views.name: rulings_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  date,
  text
FROM
  rulings
views.description: Row-level projection of rulings linked to cards by uuid. One row per ruling entry; includes the card uuid to join back to card rows. Useful to collect all ruling texts for a card.
validated_on: Indicates the number of cards with pre-modern format, ruling text "This is a triggered mana ability." that do not have multiple faces.

views.name: cards_with_rulings_join
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.hasContentWarning AS hasContentWarning,
  rulings.id AS ruling_id,
  rulings.text AS ruling_text,
  rulings.date AS ruling_date
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized join of cards to rulings (left join) so each card row is repeated for each associated ruling; cards without rulings will have NULL ruling fields. Grain is one row per (cards.id, rulings.id) pair, with rulings.id NULL for cards that have no rulings.

views.name: cards_base_18
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.isPromo AS isPromo
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical card-level row with key identity, display fields and common flags (normalized projection of cards table).

views.name: rulings_per_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  COUNT(rulings.id) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings
GROUP BY rulings.uuid

semantic_filters.--: Only include rulings that exist (no additional filter). This is a pure aggregation over rulings table.

views.description: Aggregate count of rulings per card UUID (one row per card.uuid), exposing the ruling count and allowing joins to card metadata.

views.name: cards_with_ruling_counts
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.artist AS artist,
  c.isPromo AS isPromo,
  COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.id, c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo

semantic_filters.--: This view includes only cards that appear in rulings (INNER JOIN). If a broader set is needed, use cards_base and join to rulings_per_card with LEFT JOIN in final query.

views.description: Denormalized view joining cards to their rulings count (one row per cards.id). Useful for queries that need card attributes alongside ruling_count and simple tie-breaks by card id.

views.name: card_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.type AS type,
  c.colors AS colors
FROM cards c
WHERE c.uuid IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical projection of the cards table at one row per card (normalizes and exposes key identifying and grouping columns). Useful as the fundamental card entity for counts, joins, and filtering by set, type, uuid, etc.

views.name: foreign_data_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid
FROM foreign_data
WHERE foreign_data.uuid IS NOT NULL
views.description: Canonical projection of foreign_data rows exposing the language and linking uuid to cards. One row per foreign_data.id (one foreign translation entry). Useful to determine existence of translations per card and to filter translations by language.

views.name: card_translation_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  MAX(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_chinese_simplified,
  COUNT(fd.id) AS total_foreign_rows
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.uuid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.uuid
views.description: Per-card aggregation that indicates which languages are present for a given card (one row per cards.uuid). Exposes boolean flags or counts per language to make language-presence filters and counts efficient in downstream queries.

views.name: cards_row_level_24
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  -- normalize empty strings to NULL for numeric-like fields
  NULLIF(NULLIF(cards.power, ''), 'None') AS power,
  NULLIF(NULLIF(cards.toughness, ''), 'None') AS toughness,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical row-level projection of the cards table exposing stable identifiers and core attributes (casts/normalization should happen here). Useful as a base cohort for filters like power, toughness, name, type, set, and identifiers.

views.name: cards_power_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.power AS power,
  CASE WHEN c.power = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_infinite_power
FROM cards c
views.description: Predefined cohort for cards annotated by whether their power value matches common patterns (literal values preserved). Exposes the raw power string and a boolean flag for infinite-power marker '*' to simplify filtering in questions.

views.name: cards_with_set_info
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.power AS power,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  s.code AS "sets.code",
  s.name AS "sets.name",
  s.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate"
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s
  ON c.setCode = s.code
views.description: Denormalized card rows joined to their set metadata (e.g., releaseDate, code, name) to support filters and group-bys by set attributes alongside card attributes.

views.name: cards_row_level_27
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.type AS type,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.colors AS colors,
  c.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards c
views.description: One normalized row per card as stored in the cards table; exposes primary key, identifying attributes and common filterable/display columns with minimal cleaning (NULLs preserved). Useful as the base relation for lookups, filters, and joins to card-related tables.

views.name: cards_by_uuid_with_legalities
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS "legalities.id",
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.borderColor AS "cards.borderColor",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status"
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards to legalities (one row per card id / legality row) to easily filter or aggregate card legal status by format. Keeps card identity columns and the linked legality format/status.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_names
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.uuid AS "foreign_data.uuid",
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name",
  cards.borderColor AS "cards.borderColor"
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized mapping of cards to their foreign_data rows (one row per foreign_data entry) exposing card identity and localized name/text; useful for language-specific lookups or detecting localized variants of a card.

views.name: cards_core_projection_30
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(cards.name, ''), NULLIF(cards.asciiName, ''), cards.uuid) AS name,
  NULLIF(cards.text, '') AS text,
  NULLIF(cards.originalText, '') AS originalText,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.id AS id
FROM cards
views.description: Canonical projection of cards with the primary identity and textual/oracle fields; normalizes NULL/empty strings and exposes key columns used for joins and filters.

views.name: card_rulings_denorm
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  rulings.uuid AS uuid,
  rulings.date AS date,
  rulings.text AS text,
  rulings.id AS id
FROM rulings
views.description: Denormalized one-row-per-ruling joined to the card uuid, exposing ruling text and date so callers can aggregate or pick latest/concatenated rulings per card.

views.name: card_with_rulings_wide
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.originalText AS originalText,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  rulings.date AS ruling_date,
  rulings.text AS ruling_text,
  rulings.id AS ruling_id
FROM cards
LEFT JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Wide denormalized view: one row per card (by uuid) with card core fields plus associated ruling rows left-joined. This view is one row per (card, ruling) — callers can restrict to cards without rulings or aggregate rulings into a single oracle-like string.

views.name: cards_bordercolor_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  (c.borderColor IS NULL) AS is_borderColor_null,
  CASE
    WHEN c.borderColor IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN TRIM(c.borderColor) = '' THEN ''
    ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.borderColor))
  END AS borderColor_normalized
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort of cards with their borderColor status and NULL-ness flags to simplify filters distinguishing explicit values vs NULLs.

views.name: cards_set_counts_prep
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode AS setCode,
  COUNT(id) AS total_cards_in_set,
  SUM(CASE WHEN borderColor = 'borderless' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS borderless_cards_in_set
FROM cards
GROUP BY setCode
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts per setCode: total cards per set and borderless cards per set. Useful for set-level percentages and breakdowns.

views.name: cards_story_spotlight_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  CASE
    WHEN c.isStorySpotlight IS NULL THEN 0
    WHEN c.isStorySpotlight = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS isStorySpotlight,
  c.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards c
views.description: One-row-per-card cohort projecting card identity and the isStorySpotlight flag (cleaned) so downstream queries can filter or join on story-spotlight status.

views.name: card_foreign_languages
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.type AS type,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid
FROM foreign_data
views.description: All foreign language entries for cards. One row per foreign_data entry (linked to card uuid) exposing the language and textual fields so callers can test existence of translations in a given language.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_language_presence
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  CASE WHEN COUNT(f.id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_any_foreign_data,
  COUNT(f.id) AS foreign_count_total,
  json_group_object(f.language, lang_counts.count) AS foreign_count_by_language_json
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT uuid AS fu, language AS fl, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM foreign_data
  GROUP BY uuid, language
) AS lang_counts ON lang_counts.fu = c.uuid AND lang_counts.fl = f.language
GROUP BY c.uuid, c.id, c.name
views.description: Per-card boolean presence flags for whether the card has at least one foreign_data entry in each language. Produces one row per card (by uuid) with counts per language so callers can compute cohorts like 'cards that have French entries'.

views.name: cards_row_level_38
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  COALESCE(c.uuid, '') AS uuid,
  COALESCE(c.name, '') AS name,
  COALESCE(c.originalType, '') AS originalType,
  COALESCE(c.subtypes, '') AS subtypes,
  COALESCE(c.setCode, '') AS setCode,
  COALESCE(s.releaseDate, c.originalReleaseDate, '') AS releaseDate
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
views.description: Canonical normalized row-level projection of the cards table exposing primary id, uuid and the type/subtype text fields and other common filterable attributes. Casts/normalizes NULLs and keeps raw text columns for downstream filters.

views.name: cards_type_subtype_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.originalType,
  c.subtypes
FROM cards c
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards exposing only the type and subtype related columns (one row per card) to support queries filtering by originalType and subtypes values.

views.name: cards_with_set_metadata
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.originalType AS originalType,
  c.subtypes AS subtypes,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  s.name AS "sets.name",
  s.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate"
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s
  ON c.setCode = s.code
views.description: Denormalized row-level view joining cards to their set (by setCode -> sets.code) to provide card-level attributes plus set releaseDate and set name for temporal or set-based filtering and grouping.

views.name: cards_base_41
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.duelDeck AS duelDeck,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.types AS types,
  cards.subtypes AS subtypes,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.colorIdentity AS colorIdentity,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.toughness AS toughness,
  cards.isPromo AS isPromo,
  cards.isReprint AS isReprint,
  cards.isOnlineOnly AS isOnlineOnly
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of the cards table exposing identifying columns and common attributes used for filtering and grouping (one row per card). Does light type-canonicalization by exposing raw columns; no heavy transformations or aggregations.

views.name: cards_by_dueldeck_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.duelDeck AS duelDeck
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort of cards partitioned by duelDeck value. One row per card; intended for rapid filtering by duelDeck or other card-level attributes.

views.name: card_with_set_info
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  s.code AS "sets.code",
  s.name AS "sets.name",
  s.releaseDate AS "sets.releaseDate",
  c.duelDeck AS duelDeck
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN sets s
  ON c.setCode = s.code
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards to sets via setCode to expose card attributes alongside set release and set metadata useful for temporal and set-based filtering. One row per card.

views.name: cards_row_level_44
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.borderColor AS borderColor,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.colors AS colors,
  c.type AS type,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Canonical per-card row with core identifying and filterable attributes from the cards table. Keeps raw columns useful for filtering, joining and final aggregation without applying question-specific literals.

views.name: legalities_row_level_45
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS id,
  legalities.uuid AS uuid,
  legalities.format AS format,
  legalities.status AS status
FROM legalities
views.description: Per-legal-status row from the legalities table, exposing the format and status per card UUID for joins and filtering by status.

views.name: cards_with_legalities_46
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  legalities.id AS "legalities.id",
  legalities.uuid AS "legalities.uuid",
  legalities.format AS "legalities.format",
  legalities.status AS "legalities.status",
  cards.id AS "cards.id as card_id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid as card_uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.borderColor AS "cards.borderColor",
  cards.setCode AS "cards.setCode",
  cards.rarity AS "cards.rarity"
FROM legalities
JOIN cards ON legalities.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized per-card-per-legality join: one row per legality record augmented with card attributes. Suitable for cohort filters like cards that are banned, restricted, or legal in a specific format.

views.name: cards_core_projection_47
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.originalType AS originalType,
  cards.colors AS colors,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.rarity AS rarity,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of key card attributes used for filtering, identification, and joins. Keeps original schema values without applying question-specific literals.

views.name: foreign_data_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  -- comma-separated distinct languages available for this card's uuid
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.language) AS foreign_language_list,
  -- count of distinct languages
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data f
  ON f.uuid = c.uuid
GROUP BY c.uuid
views.description: Aggregated list of distinct foreign languages available per card uuid. One row per card (uuid) with comma-separated distinct languages and a language count. Useful to check if translations exist and to enumerate languages.

views.name: cards_with_translations
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.originalType AS originalType,
  c.colors AS colors,
  -- aggregated comma-separated list of distinct languages for this card from foreign_data
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(language, ',') 
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT language
      FROM foreign_data fd
      WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
      ORDER BY language
    )
  ) AS foreign_language_list,
  -- count of distinct foreign_data rows (by id) for this card
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) 
    FROM foreign_data fd2
    WHERE fd2.uuid = c.uuid
  ) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards c
views.description: Denormalized view joining cards to aggregated foreign_data per card. One row per card (cards.id/uuid) including the comma-separated language list and translation count; useful for queries that need card identifying fields plus whether and which translations exist.

views.name: cards_row_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  uuid,
  name,
  manaCost,
  layout,
  frameVersion,
  borderColor,
  availability,
  setCode,
  type,
  rarity,
  colors,
  colorIdentity,
  convertedManaCost
FROM cards
views.description: Row-level cohort of cards with basic identifying and commonly filtered columns; one row per card (no aggregation). Useful as the base cohort for filters like layout, frameVersion, borderColor, availability, set membership, and other card-level queries.

views.name: cards_normalized_texts_and_ids
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.uuid), '') AS uuid,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.name), '') AS name,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.asciiName), '') AS asciiName,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.manaCost), '') AS manaCost,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.text), '') AS text,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.originalText), '') AS originalText,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.flavorText), '') AS flavorText,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.type), '') AS type,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.layout), '') AS layout,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.frameVersion), '') AS frameVersion,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.borderColor), '') AS borderColor,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.availability), '') AS availability,
  NULLIF(TRIM(cards.setCode), '') AS setCode
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized/cleaned projection of card textual fields and identifiers. Canonicalizes key text fields to NULL when empty and exposes ids and uuids for joins. One row per card. Useful for text searches, translations, rulings, and joins to other tables.

views.name: card_foreign_texts_by_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.uuid AS "foreign_data.uuid",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name",
  foreign_data.text AS "foreign_data.text",
  foreign_data.flavorText AS "foreign_data.flavorText",
  cards.id AS "cards.id AS card_id",
  cards.name AS "cards.name AS card_name",
  cards.manaCost AS "cards.manaCost",
  cards.layout AS "cards.layout",
  cards.frameVersion AS "cards.frameVersion"
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized relation linking cards (by uuid) to their foreign_data rows (translations, localized text and names). One row per foreign_data record (linked to a card uuid). Useful to filter or display localized names/texts and to deduplicate cards by language-specific fields.

views.name: cards_core_flags_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.isStorySpotlight AS isStorySpotlight,
  c.isTextless AS isTextless
FROM cards c
views.description: One-row-per-card cohort exposing core card id and important boolean flag columns and basic identifying fields for filtering and grouping (story spotlight, textless, reprint, promo, set). Useful as the base cohort for counts, percentages, and lists of cards matching boolean conditions.

views.name: cards_identifiers_projection
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  CAST(COALESCE(c.isStorySpotlight, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isStorySpotlight,
  CAST(COALESCE(c.isTextless, 0) AS INTEGER) AS isTextless
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Normalized projection of cards to expose canonical identifier columns and textual name fields, casting boolean-ish integer flags to integer and ensuring key columns present. Useful for joins, dedup, and presenting IDs/names consistently.

views.name: cards_with_foreign_and_legality_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_foreign_data,
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legalities l WHERE l.uuid = c.uuid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_legalities,
  c.isStorySpotlight AS isStorySpotlight,
  c.isTextless AS isTextless
FROM cards c
views.description: Denormalized card-level view joining cards to their foreign_data and legalities presence flags (not duplicating rows for multiple foreign_data/legalities entries). Exposes whether translations or legalities exist for a card plus core id and flags. Useful for filters that combine translation/legal status with card flags.

views.name: sets_core_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  block AS block,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type
FROM sets
views.description: Canonical projection of sets with commonly used identifying and classification columns, cleaned for downstream joins and filtering.

views.name: set_translations_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  setCode,
  language,
  translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: Row-level set translations; one row per translation entry for a set (language-specific translation).

views.name: sets_with_translation_flags
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sets.code AS code,
  sets.name AS name,
  sets.block AS block,
  -- flag: whether there exists at least one translation row for this set in language 'Portuguese (Brazil)'
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM set_translations st
    WHERE st.setCode = sets.code
      AND st.language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)'
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_portuguese_brazil,
  -- count of translation rows for this set in language 'Portuguese (Brazil)'
  COALESCE((
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM set_translations st2
    WHERE st2.setCode = sets.code
      AND st2.language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)'
  ), 0) AS portuguese_brazil_translation_count,
  sets.id AS sets_id
FROM sets
views.description: One row per set (sets.code) with a boolean flag and count indicating whether translations exist in each language; useful to filter sets having translations in a given language.

views.name: cards_core_59
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  uuid,
  name,
  setCode,
  types,
  supertypes,
  subtypes
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of the cards table exposing identifying columns and type-related columns (supertypes, subtypes, types) for downstream joins and filters.

views.name: foreign_data_by_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Subset of foreign_data rows scoped by language to form cohorts of card translations; one row per foreign_data record (linked to a card by uuid).

views.name: cards_with_foreign_language
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS "foreign_data.id",
  foreign_data.uuid AS "foreign_data.uuid",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid AS card_uuid",
  foreign_data.language AS "foreign_data.language",
  cards.subtypes AS "cards.subtypes",
  cards.supertypes AS "cards.supertypes",
  cards.types AS "cards.types",
  cards.name AS "cards.name AS card_name",
  foreign_data.name AS "foreign_data.name AS foreign_name"
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized join of cards to foreign_data producing one row per foreign_data record enriched with the card's type fields; useful for questions that restrict by translation language and then inspect card attributes.

views.name: cards_row_level_62
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.text AS text,
  cards.power AS power
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized row-level projection of cards exposing identity, text, and power/toughness-related columns for filtering and downstream cohorts. Casts and canonicalization are minimal (preserve NULLs).

views.name: cards_text_search_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  LOWER(COALESCE(c.text, '')) AS text_lower
FROM cards c
views.description: Cohort of cards whose text contains a normalized lowercase text field to support case-insensitive substring searches and text-based filtering.

views.name: cards_power_status_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.uuid,
  c.name,
  c.power,
  CASE
    WHEN c.power IS NULL THEN 1
    WHEN trim(c.power) = '' THEN 1
    WHEN c.power = '*' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS power_is_unknown
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Cohort of cards annotated with a canonical power_status flag indicating unknown/missing power (power IS NULL or power = '*') to help filter by power availability.

views.name: cards_base_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.side AS side
FROM cards c
views.description: Canonical card row with key identifying columns and common card attributes normalized for downstream joins. One row per card (one physical card face/entry in the cards table).

views.name: cards_with_rulings_join_66
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS "cards.id",
  cards.uuid AS "cards.uuid",
  cards.name AS "cards.name",
  cards.side AS "cards.side",
  rulings.id AS "rulings.id",
  rulings.uuid AS "rulings.uuid",
  rulings.date AS "rulings.date",
  rulings.text AS "rulings.text",
  NULL AS "rulings.format"
FROM cards
JOIN rulings ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized join of cards to rulings (one row per ruling) — exposes card id/uuid and ruling id/text/date to support counting cards matching ruling filters while preserving card identity and card attributes like side. Useful for cohort counts where filters apply to both cards and their rulings.

views.name: cards_core_attributes
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.artist AS artist,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.borderColor AS borderColor,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.id AS id
FROM cards
views.description: Normalized projection of core card attributes used for filtering and joining to foreign/localized data. One row per card (identified by cards.uuid). Casts and canonicalizes a few textual flags for easier filters.

views.name: foreign_names_by_card
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS foreign_id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS cards_name,
  cards.artist AS cards_artist,
  cards.type AS cards_type,
  cards.layout AS cards_layout,
  cards.borderColor AS cards_borderColor,
  foreign_data.name AS foreign_name,
  foreign_data.language AS foreign_language,
  foreign_data.text AS foreign_text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS foreign_flavorText
FROM foreign_data
JOIN cards ON foreign_data.uuid = cards.uuid
views.description: Denormalized mapping of each card (cards.uuid) to its foreign/localized entries from foreign_data. One row per foreign_data row (language-specific name/text) joined to the canonical card attributes.

views.name: sets_base_properties
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  code AS code,
  name AS name,
  baseSetSize AS baseSetSize,
  block AS block,
  releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  type AS type
FROM sets
views.description: Canonical per-set properties used to filter and join sets (basic metadata and numeric fields normalized). One row per set identified by its code.

views.name: set_translations_by_set
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  setCode,
  language,
  translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: Per-translation row for sets: one row per set translation (language and translated name). Exposes setCode for joining to sets.code.

views.name: sets_with_translations_joined
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  set_translations.id AS "set_translations.id",
  set_translations.setCode AS "set_translations.setCode",
  set_translations.language AS "set_translations.language",
  set_translations.translation AS "set_translations.translation",
  sets.code AS "sets.code",
  sets.name AS "sets.name",
  sets.baseSetSize AS "sets.baseSetSize",
  sets.block AS "sets.block"
FROM set_translations
JOIN sets ON set_translations.setCode = sets.code
views.description: Denormalized view joining sets to their translations. One row per set translation (i.e., many rows per set if multiple translations). Useful for questions that need translation language/text alongside set metadata.

views.name: cards_basic_status
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  COALESCE(c.setCode, NULL) AS setCode,
  -- canonicalize boolean-ish integer flags to 0/1
  CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning IS NOT NULL THEN (c.hasContentWarning != 0) ELSE 0 END AS hasContentWarning,
  CASE WHEN c.isOnlineOnly IS NOT NULL THEN (c.isOnlineOnly != 0) ELSE 0 END AS isOnlineOnly,
  CASE WHEN c.isPromo IS NOT NULL THEN (c.isPromo != 0) ELSE 0 END AS isPromo,
  CASE WHEN c.isReprint IS NOT NULL THEN (c.isReprint != 0) ELSE 0 END AS isReprint,
  COALESCE(c.rarity, '') AS rarity,
  COALESCE(c.types, '') AS types,
  COALESCE(c.colors, '') AS colors,
  -- ensure numeric canonicalization for converted mana cost; leave NULL if absent
  CASE
    WHEN c.convertedManaCost IS NOT NULL THEN c.convertedManaCost
    WHEN c.convertedManaCost = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards AS c
views.description: One row per card (cards table row) normalized to expose canonical identifiers and boolean flags relevant for filtering (content warning, legalities link via uuid, and set/code info). Casts and canonicalization for reuse.

views.name: cards_with_commander_legality_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.hasContentWarning AS hasContentWarning
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l
  ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.format = 'commander'
GROUP BY c.id, c.uuid, c.name, c.setCode, c.hasContentWarning
views.description: Cohort of cards that are linked to a 'commander' format legality record (not final status filter) — one row per card id. This view is a reusable subset representing cards participating in a specified format; final queries can further restrict by legality.status.

views.name: cards_core_attributes_74
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.name AS name,
  cards.power AS power,
  cards.setCode AS setCode,
  cards.type AS type,
  cards.manaCost AS manaCost,
  cards.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards
views.description: One row per card (cards.uuid). Exposes canonical card identity and key attributes useful for filtering and joins (power, name, set, type, and other basic fields). Normalizes empty-string vs NULL where appropriate by keeping raw SQL columns for downstream NULL checks.

views.name: cards_no_power_with_foreign_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  -- is_no_power: true-like (1) when power is NULL or empty string; 0 otherwise
  CASE WHEN c.power IS NULL OR trim(c.power) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_no_power,
  -- has_foreign_translation: true-like (1) when at least one foreign_data row exists for this uuid; 0 otherwise
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.uuid = c.uuid
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_foreign_translation
FROM cards c
views.description: One row per card (cards.uuid). Marks whether the card meets 'no power' condition and whether it has at least one foreign_data row in a given language. This view does not hardcode any language literal; it exposes a boolean-like indicator per language via presence rows (use question_ops to restrict language).

views.name: foreign_data_rows
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  foreign_data.id AS id,
  foreign_data.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  foreign_data.language AS language,
  foreign_data.uuid AS uuid,
  foreign_data.name AS name,
  foreign_data.text AS text,
  foreign_data.flavorText AS flavorText,
  foreign_data.type AS type
FROM foreign_data
views.description: Row-level cohort of all foreign_data rows (one row per foreign_data.id) with original columns; useful to filter by multiverseid, language, uuid, and text.

views.name: cards_by_uuid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.id AS id,
  c.name AS name,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.multiverseId AS multiverseId,
  c.scryfallId AS scryfallId,
  c.type AS type,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.colors AS colors
FROM cards c
views.description: Row-level view of cards keyed by uuid (one row per cards.uuid) exposing identifying and set columns for joining to foreign_data, legalities, rulings, and sets.

views.name: foreign_data_latest_per_multiverseid
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  fd.multiverseid AS multiverseid,
  fd.id AS id,
  fd.language AS language,
  fd.uuid AS uuid,
  fd.name AS name,
  fd.text AS text,
  fd.flavorText AS flavorText,
  fd.type AS type
FROM foreign_data fd
JOIN (
  SELECT multiverseid, MAX(id) AS max_id
  FROM foreign_data
  WHERE multiverseid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY multiverseid
) latest ON latest.multiverseid = fd.multiverseid AND latest.max_id = fd.id
views.description: For each foreign_data.multiverseid, pick the latest (highest id) foreign_data row to deduplicate cases with multiple translations for same multiverseid; one row per multiverseid.

views.name: cards_row_level_79
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.id AS id,
  c.uuid AS uuid,
  c.name AS name,
  c.layout AS layout,
  c.isTextless AS isTextless,
  c.type AS type,
  c.types AS types,
  c.subtypes AS subtypes,
  c.supertypes AS supertypes,
  c.setCode AS setCode,
  c.rarity AS rarity,
  c.manaCost AS manaCost,
  c.convertedManaCost AS convertedManaCost
FROM cards AS c
views.description: Canonical single-row-per-card projection with normalized column types and key/display fields exposed for downstream cohort/filtering and aggregation.

views.name: cards_textless_layout_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  cards.id AS id,
  cards.uuid AS uuid,
  cards.layout AS layout,
  cards.isTextless AS isTextless,
  cards.setCode AS setCode
FROM cards
WHERE cards.isTextless IS NOT NULL
  AND cards.layout IS NOT NULL
views.description: Cohort view selecting cards that match a layout value and an isTextless flag; still one row per card to allow counts, percentages, and further grouping.

views.name: cards_counts_by_layout_textless_flag
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  layout,
  isTextless,
  COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
GROUP BY
  layout,
  isTextless
views.description: Aggregated counts of cards by layout value and isTextless flag (keeps both dimensions so percentage computation and breakdowns can be derived later).

views.name: sets_row
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  sets.code AS code,
  sets.mcmName AS mcmName,
  sets.name AS name,
  sets.releaseDate AS releaseDate,
  sets.type AS type,
  sets.id AS sets_id
FROM sets
views.description: One row per set with canonical basic set identifiers and names (cohort of all sets).

views.name: set_translations_by_set_83
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  set_translations.id AS id,
  set_translations.setCode AS setCode,
  set_translations.language AS language,
  set_translations.translation AS translation
FROM set_translations
views.description: Translations for sets: one row per translation entry (language/translation) linked to the parent set code.

views.name: set_languages_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  setCode AS setCode,
  language AS language
FROM set_translations
WHERE setCode IS NOT NULL
  AND language IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY setCode, language
views.description: Distinct languages available per set code: one row per (setCode, language). Useful for queries that list which languages a set has translations for.
